title: GLITCH
summary: Repeats small pieces of the sound in time: stutters, fills and machine-gun rolls.
steps: Add GLITCH to drums, a lead or the whole bus.
Rate says how small the pieces are (1/16, 1/32...).
Chance says how often it happens.

examples.title: A stutter
examples.text: Short 1/32 stutters on a hi-tech lead.

examples.title: A fill before a section
examples.text: 1/16 repeats at the end of a phrase.

examples.title: A backspin
examples.text: Pieces played backwards, like a DJ spin.

styles.why: Slow far-away echoes and reverse fills.
